objects.summary: P2 F2 review finds non-gating longshot mirror does not reuse all primary-universe filters (binary/result/minimum-duration), so it can compare a different sample while being labelled a side-only sensitivity. Mirror must reuse the exact primary predicate and change only purchased side.

P1 WP2 review proves the synthetic binding only plans and verify_bindings; runner.execute is never invoked and execution/evaluation lineage is falsely claimed. Existing documentary execution/validation components must be exercised and persisted before COMPLETE.

P2 WP2 review finds fixture digest is cached in constructor, neither persisted with task before claim nor recomputed from consumed inputs; crash/recovery or post-construction input mutation can complete same task ID with changed or mismatched fixture identity.

P1 PR46 review proves model-issued CONTINUE can replace next builder prompt with unrestricted instructions while authority checks remain only on original task metadata; a continuation can request scientific unblinding/live trading unless immutable engineering authority is carried across delegation.

P1 PR46 review proves same GitHub bot identity can pre-seed a PASS review marker in builder response before any review request and drive state to QUALIFIED_RESULT/DONE. Review acceptance must bind to a distinct post-request review execution/run, not only shared actor plus predictable marker fields.

cross_object_findings.finding: A mirror test cannot be interpreted as side-only sensitivity if its eligibility universe differs from the primary test; all non-varied predicates must be reused exactly.

WP2 demonstrated that a receipt can look causally complete while never invoking the executor. Completion claims must carry identities/evidence for actual execution result and evaluation, not only a frozen plan and binding check.

Task recovery is not trustworthy if seed/config/qualification identity can change under the same durable task ID. Expected fixture identity must be persisted before first claim and recomputed from actual consumed inputs on every execution/recovery.

Validating an action label is insufficient when model-generated continuation text can widen scope. Immutable authority denials and engineering envelope must be machine-enforced on every delegated next task.

Shared bot principal and predictable review marker fields do not prove a separate review occurred. Review evidence must be causally downstream of the specific review request and independently identifiable from builder result production.
